physical: In an alternating-current circuit the ratio of voltage to current is the impedance, whose magnitude combines resistance with the inductive and capacitive reactances. |Z| = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²)
reflected_sentence: The definition of the opposition's size as a combination of its parts keeps its shape, even though every part of it is made of opposition.
rule_reason: A definition: it states how opposition's parts combine, not a cost that rises with resistance, so under the rule definitions keep their shape.
interpretation: The gap has parts, and this says how the parts compose the whole. It is a definition, so the shape survives the mirror. On the nonphysical side the whole of it can only appear as the gap.
closing: The rule decided via the form: definition, hence keeps, even though every quantity involved carries resistance in the fixed table. I noted the tension in closing rather than the reflection: one could argue the whole definition is opposition and should turn, but the rule assigns turns only to costs and limits, so keeps it is.
